mapper.insert: insert into orders (number, submit_token, user_id, merchant_id, address_id, status, pay_status, pay_method, amount, delivery_fee, remark, consignee, phone, address, order_time, checkout_time, estimated_delivery_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{number}, #{submitToken}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{addressId}, #{status}, #{payStatus}, #{payMethod}, #{amount}, #{deliveryFee}, #{remark}, #{consignee}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{orderTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select count(id) from orders where user_id = #{userId} and submit_token = #{token}
select count(id) from orders where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = #{status}
select * from orders where status = #{status} and order_time < #{orderTime}
mapper.update: update orders set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancel_time = #{now}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
update orders set status = 'PAID', pay_status = 'PAID', checkout_time = #{checkoutTime}, pay_method = #{payMethod}, update_time = now() where number = #{orderNumber} and status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
